candidates.title: Scheduler evicts by model path when keep_alive ties, not by size or recency
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  When a new model needs room, `findRunnerToUnload` (`server/sched.go`) sorts loaded runners by `sessionDuration`, then by model path, and unloads the first idle one. Most setups give every model the same keep_alive (the default, or `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE`), so the deciding key is the model path.
